findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "business" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_pccc, check_email_valid, app_reviews, registry_realestate_jobs_create, registry_corporate_jobs_create · Private data: land_rt_price, get_car_flooding, get_car_scrap, geo_batch_geocode · Public sink: check_email_valid, rtms_rent, registry_realestate_jobs_create, registry_corporate_jobs_create · Destructive: check_phone_valid.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_pccc, check_email_valid, app_reviews, registry_realestate_jobs_create, registry_corporate_jobs_create · Private data: land_rt_price, get_car_flooding, get_car_scrap, geo_batch_geocode · Public sink: check_email_valid, rtms_rent, registry_realestate_jobs_create, registry_corporate_jobs_create · Destructive: check_phone_valid

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
